verdict.rationale: CoreWeave's own docs name a first-party 'Mission Control MCP server' for investigating the environment and making supported changes, so an official MCP server exists. The evidence is a single line on the docs landing page, and 'supported changes' suggests limited write scope. missing for 10: connection/setup documentation, authentication details, list of exposed tools and resources, clarity on which changes are supported, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Mission Control Agent and the Mission Control MCP server for investigating your environment and making supported changes.
